What’s included

Creator selection

A shortlist of creators chosen for audience, engagement and fit — not follower count alone.

Campaign concept

One clear idea that every creator can make their own.

Briefs & coordination

Briefs, schedules and visits arranged with each creator.

Micro & UGC creators

Authentic content at scale from smaller creators, for organic posts and ads.

Content approval

Every piece reviewed against the brief before it goes live.

Reporting

Views, reach and engagement per creator, in one report.

How a campaign runs

  1. 01

    Brief

    We agree on the goal, audience, budget and markets.

  2. 02

    Match

    We propose creators from our network for your approval.

  3. 03

    Create

    Creators visit, film and send content for review.

  4. 04

    Report

    We track every post and report results per creator.

Questions we get asked

Which countries does your influencer network cover?

Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE, Oman and Jordan.

Do you work with micro and UGC creators?

Yes. Alongside known influencers, we run campaigns with micro and UGC creators for authentic content and ad material.

Can influencers visit our restaurant or clinic?

Yes. We arrange creator visits and blogger days and brief each creator before they arrive.

How do you choose the right influencers?

We look at audience location, engagement and content style, then propose a shortlist for your approval.

Let the right people talk about you

Tell us your audience and budget and we’ll propose creators for your campaign.
